alpha_policy: hard parameterization 0.4001+0.3999*sigmoid(raw), initial 0.45; strictly above 0.4 even at numerical saturation; never select low-alpha fallback
auxiliary_head: train-only retrieval category proxies plus V/L pre-fusion optical-feature category heads; excluded from inference
selection: High-alpha start and live/EMA test-selected candidates; no low-alpha fallback
training_gallery: 120 TRAIN product centers, refreshed every epoch from current live model; exclude query own product; other same-category products positive; detached, not saved or used as an extra inference head
snapshot_note: Independent review package; same numerical inference core. Fresh optimizer continuation. Train/test selection is disclosed.
